proposals.evidence: Turner’s granthi knot family explicitly includes Sindhi gaṇḍhi onion bulb and Lahnda gaḍḍh onion/gaṇḍhā bulb, beside Hindi gā̃ṭhī/gā̃ṭhā. The Gujari/Dogri and Haryanvi/Buksa onion responses match this documented bulb sense; nasal versus written nasal-stop and aspiration realizations remain as transcribed. The unrelated kanda onion series is kept separate.
